watch.text: Caruso, Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Wallace, Topic, Mara and Jaylin Williams are out at IND on the 5:30 PM ET official report on 11/23.
SGA (neck/back) missed Sunday's loss at Miami but is off Monday's injury report and expected to play at Indiana.
Giannis Antetokounmpo (right groin tendinitis, limited Saturday) is questionable vs OKC; he has played every game this season, so ratings assume him.
Stephen Curry (oblique tear) has missed 3 straight and is out vs BOS, estimated back about Dec 12; ratings still lean on the 13 games he played. Porzingis and Butler are also out.
Tatum and White sat the 97-96 loss at SAC on 11/21 but are off the 11/22 report vs GS; that loss understates the Boston that plays tonight.
Paul George (rest) and Mitchell Robinson (illness) are out at GS on 11/22; ratings built with George overstate Boston tonight.

Norman Powell (hamstring) and Caleb Wilson (hand fracture) are both out vs CLE on the NBA's 6:30 PM ET report on 11/23, and Nic Claxton is questionable (illness): the Bulls are without their two leading scorers.
OG Anunoby (calf) is out vs IND for a second straight game and Miles McBride (abdomen) is out too, per the evening 11/22 report.
Siakam (hip) is questionable vs OKC on 11/23; Nesmith and McConnell are out and Haliburton remains out.
P.J. Washington (illness) is doubtful at UTAH on 11/22 after missing 11/21 vs LAC; Walter Clayton Jr. is questionable on the back-to-back.
CJ McCollum (calf) is out at least four weeks from 11/17 and Landale is out; Flemings (lumbar) is questionable vs DET.
Duncan Robinson (quad, since 11/17) and Jalen Duren (hamstring, 11 games) are out at ATL; Cade Cunningham (knee) is probable.
Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture, 11/11, at least a month) has missed 9 straight games and Jaren Jackson Jr. (MCL) 14 straight; ratings still carry early games with them.
Paolo Banchero (high-ankle sprain, 4-6 weeks from 10/24) has missed 10 of 15 games; a return could come soon, check before tip.
Joel Embiid (32 mpg) is still questionable vs POR on 11/23 (illness, 5:30 PM ET official report); if he sits, ratings built with him overstate PHI tonight.
Jaylen Brown and Dean Wade (hamstrings) missed the last two games and are probable vs POR on 11/23; those two games understate Philadelphia.
Wembanyama (low back tightness, has not missed a game) and Fox (shin) are questionable on Monday's report, evaluated before the 10 PM ET tip; Harper, Harris out.
Ja Morant (hamstring, est. Dec 1) and Shaedon Sharpe (meniscus, est. March) are out.
Cameron Boozer (30.8 mpg, ankle) and Jerami Grant (calf) are out at CHA on the 5:30 PM ET official report on 11/23; GG Jackson, Pippen Jr. and Saunders are out too.
Allen (concussion), Schroder, Grant Williams and Knueppel are out vs MEM on 11/23; Brandon Miller (knee) is listed available on the 5:30 PM ET official report.
Austin Reaves (35.2 mpg, left heel bruise) is ruled out vs Utah on 11/23, his 4th straight missed game despite a full practice Sunday; Friday at San Antonio is the target.
Walker Kessler returns from injury for Monday's game vs Utah.
Nolan Traore (22.3 mpg) has a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in about 8-10 weeks; ratings built with him overstate Brooklyn now.
Evan Mobley (left great toe sprain) is out at CHI on the NBA's 6:30 PM ET report on 11/23, with Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back) also out; Jaylon Tyson (ankle) is probable.

401910035.summary: Curry's absence and Tatum/White returning explain most of the gap, but Boston ruling out Paul George and Mitchell Robinson on 11/22 pushes back toward GS; the line moved from Celtics -8.5 to -7.5.

reasons.text: Stephen Curry (oblique tear) is out vs BOS, ESPN estimates Dec 12; our ratings still carry his 13 games.
Tatum (rest) and White (AC joint) sat at SAC on 11/21 but are off the injury report for the GS game on 11/22.
Paul George (rest) and Mitchell Robinson (illness) were ruled out for Boston at GS on 11/22.

returning.text: Rested 11/21 at SAC; off the 11/22 injury report and expected to play at GS.
Missed 11/21 at SAC (AC joint contusion); off the 11/22 injury report vs GS.

swings.BOS: Tatum and White sat at SAC on 11/21, so the market was low on Boston there; both are off the 11/22 report, so the market prices them back at GS (RotoWire, 11/22).

swings.PHI: Jaylen Brown and Dean Wade (hamstrings) missed two games and are probable vs POR on 11/23; the market prices them back, our ratings don't (ESPN, 11/22).
swings.POR: Nothing found on Portland itself; the move most likely reflects Philadelphia's Brown and Wade being listed probable after missing two games (ESPN, 11/22).

returning.text: Probable vs POR after missing two games (hamstring).
Probable vs POR after missing two games (hamstring).

401910037.summary: Philadelphia gets Jaylen Brown and Dean Wade (hamstrings) back as probable and is on a five-game win streak, while Portland is without Ja Morant and Shaedon Sharpe; that covers part of the gap.

reasons.text: Joel Embiid is still questionable (illness) on the 5:30 PM ET official report for 11/23, which may weigh on the 76ers' price.
Brown and Wade (hamstrings) are probable vs POR after missing two games; Adem Bona is also listed.
Portland is out Ja Morant (hamstring, est. Dec 1), Shaedon Sharpe (meniscus, est. March), Vit Krejci and Chris Youngblood.

401910045.summary: Victor Wembanyama (lower back tightness, after his 50-point game) and De'Aaron Fox (shin) are both questionable at Sacramento, so the market is pricing a possible rest night.

reasons.text: Wembanyama (back) is questionable for Monday at SAC; Fox (right shin contusion) and Jordan McLaughlin (shoulder) are also questionable.

swings.SA: Wembanyama (back) and Fox (shin) were listed questionable for 11/23 after Wembanyama's 50-point game; the market discounts the Spurs, our ratings don't (NBC Sports, 11/22).

401910040.summary: Anthony Edwards has been out since Oct. 29 knee surgery, so our ratings already carry most of it; Brooklyn now loses Nolan Traore for 8-10 weeks, which pushes the other way, so the gap stays unexplained.

reasons.text: Edwards had right knee arthroscopic surgery on Oct. 29 and is expected to miss at least eight weeks (late December).
Nets: Nolan Traore (hamstring strain) will be re-evaluated in about 8-10 weeks (HoopsHype via ESPN, 11/23), which favors Minnesota, not the market's number.
5:30 PM ET report: Edwards (knee), DiVincenzo and Jaylen Clark out for Minnesota; Traore out for Brooklyn, Grant Nelson (ankle) available.

swings.BKN: Nolan Traore (hamstring strain) went from game-time decision to an 8-10 week re-evaluation on 11/23 (HoopsHype via ESPN); the market has moved on Brooklyn with it.
swings.MIN: Nothing found: the market moved on Minnesota without a clear reason; Edwards (out since Oct. 29 knee surgery), Clark and DiVincenzo were already out last game, and only Brooklyn's Traore and Nelson are game-time calls (ESPN, 11/23).

swings.PHX: Trey Murphy III (knees) is probable for New Orleans vs PHX after missing 7 of 8 games (29 min in his 11/20 return); the market prices him back, our ratings don't (Rotowire, 11/22).

swings.OKC: SGA (neck/back) missed Sunday at Miami but is off Monday's injury report (CBS, 11/23 1:42 PM); with Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Caruso still out, the gap on OKC fell from 9.7 to 1.7.

401910036.summary: Memphis is without Cameron Boozer (2nd straight game) and Jerami Grant, which pulled the line from 3.5 to 2.5, but Charlotte is missing four rotation players too, so it covers only part of our 3.5-pt gap.

reasons.text: Grizzlies: Cameron Boozer (ankle sprain, 2nd straight missed game) and Jerami Grant (calf strain, re-evaluated in two weeks) are out at Charlotte.
Hornets: Grayson Allen (concussion protocol), Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder (hamstrings) and Grant Williams are out; Brandon Miller is available (5:30 PM ET official report).
Line: Memphis opened -3.5 and most books still show -3.5; DraftKings is at -2.5.

swings.LAL: Market is higher on the Lakers than at their last game even with Austin Reaves ruled out a 4th straight game: Walker Kessler returns from injury and Utah is still without Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. (Yahoo, 11/23).
